audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-22 OPENER PART TWO - the AD&D sneak preview of the Dungeon Masters Guide, the single-chain table round of the four-round shape. Pinned: the magic items of the six modules (the amulet of the planes and its seventeen plane bands, the hammer of thunderbolts, the helm of underwater action, the Nolzur pigments, the pearl of wisdom, the periapt chart, the two philters, the water breathing potion), the four elemental command rings with their power counts and save penalties, the eight protection scrolls with their reading times and hit-dice caps, the creatures-struck-only-by-magic-weapons grades, the grenade-like missile rules, the attack matrix I.D point one for thieves assassins and monks, the cleric-undead matrix with the T D and dash symbols converted ninety-seven ninety-eight ninety-nine and zero, the psionic IV.B crush percentages IV.C blast saves and IV.D ranges, and the three saving throw matrices - the characters, the monster rules and the items. The print catches pinned as scanned: Freet Giant Jari, con penetrate, jackolwere, wralths, the Ghost row printed twice for the Ghast, Petrifaction, the farce and an die footnote, the missing I.D footnote e, the I.B armor class three eleven and the dropped armor class ten cell, the five I.C bands over four columns with the dangling Opponent, and the overlapping IV.B defender band.

banner.title: The Dragon issue-22 opener part two - the AD&D Sneak Preview of the Dungeon Masters Guide
banner.provenance: The part-two round of the issue-22 four-round shape - the single chain of the DMG sneak preview, the table round of the walk. Pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 8 (February 1979) print 33 through 38 and 41 through 43, the Curtiss-provided Dm22.pdf scan voice, print folio the PDF page this issue. The preview prints the not-yet-released DMG combat and saving throw material ahead of the GenCon XII release - the magic items of the six modules, the amulet of the planes, the elemental command rings, the protection scrolls, the attack matrices, the cleric-undead matrix, the psionic tables and the three saving throw matrices.
banner.sentinel: Conversions noted, never silent: the cleric-undead matrix pins the T symbol as ninety-seven, the D as ninety-eight, the starred destroy as ninety-nine and the printed dash as zero; the psychic crush range pins its printed dashes as zero; the parchment fireball save prints twenty-five and the fighter nine-to-ten row prints its breath and spell cells nine and eleven - all pinned as scanned. No watches moved: the Sullin levels 7-9 and the brawling sequel still print nowhere and ride to TD 23.
